title: Emerald Deco Hoops
descriptionHtml:
Green and clear, in turn. Chunky silver-tone hoops set all the way round the front with square emerald-cut green stones alternating with pairs of clear baguettes, each in bright claws. Post backs.

STYLING TIP: Let them be the statement, with hair up and no necklace.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 22mm across
  • Stones: Square emerald green cubic zirconia alternating with pairs of clear baguettes
  • Setting: Bright claws
  • Closure: Post back
  • Finish: Bright silver tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
